title: Natural-Language to SysMLv2 Translation via Conformance-Driven Iterative Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2607.14162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) relies on formal system models as primary technical artifacts for representing requirements, structure, and behavior across the system lifecycle. With the standardization of SysMLv2 as a textual language, interest is increasing in translating natural-language descriptions directly into executable models. For practical deployment, generated models must be accepted by industrial modeling environments, not merely satisfy grammar constraints. We present a conformance-checker-driven framework for reliable natural-language-to-SysMLv2 translation that enforces production-level acceptance as the termination condition. The system embeds a SysMLv2 conformance checker within a generate-check-repair loop. Each model is evaluated using the checker, and deterministic diagnostics are incorporated into revisions until zero conformance errors are achieved. translated_title: 基于一致性驱动的迭代精化的自然语言到SysMLv2转换
translated_abstract: 基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）依赖形式化的系统模型作为主要技术工件，用于在系统生命周期中表示需求、结构和行为。随着SysMLv2作为文本语言的标准化，将自然语言描述直接转换为可执行模型的兴趣日益增长。对于实际部署而言，生成的模型必须能够被工业建模环境所接受，而不仅仅是满足语法约束。我们提出了一个由一致性检查器驱动的框架，用于可靠的自然语言到SysMLv2的转换，该框架将生产级验收作为终止条件。该系统在生成-检查-修复循环中嵌入了SysMLv2一致性检查器。每个模型都通过检查器进行评估，并将确定性诊断信息纳入修订过程中，直到实现零一致性错误。使用生产检查器作为判定基准，可确保该框架……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个一致性检查器驱动的迭代精化框架，通过在生成-检查-修复循环中嵌入SysMLv2生产级一致性检查器，将自然语言描述可靠地转换为能被工业建模环境接受的SysMLv2模型，直到实现零一致性错误。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a conformance-checker-driven iterative refinement framework that reliably translates natural-language descriptions into SysMLv2 models accepted by production modeling environments, by embedding a production conformance checker in a generate-check-repair loop until zero conformance errors are achieved.
